query:
SELECT id FROM filaments
        WHERE ($1::text IS NOT NULL AND source_url = $1)
           OR (brand_id = $2 AND material_id = $3
               AND lower(coalesce(product_name, '')) = lower(coalesce($4, ''))
               AND lower(color_name) = lower($5)
               AND diameter_mm = $6)
        LIMIT 1
